neck.curve_convention: 64 ellipse samples; last connects to first

specification.graph_policy: Preserve every incident edge and outlet; sac is a lesion, not a daughter artery

trace.limitation: Front-facing triangle projection trace only. Multiple layers, gaps or coplanar ambiguity remain UNKNOWN. No source faces removed, no lumen union or tangent continuity.

opening.limitation: Source-face partitions; no dome union, contact or anatomical acceptance.

rim_inspection.limitation: Front-facing triangle projection trace only. Multiple layers, gaps or coplanar ambiguity remain UNKNOWN. No source faces removed, no lumen union or tangent continuity.

self_contact.limitations: Finite-precision tests, not exact predicates. Other vessels not checked. Adjacent pairs check overlap beyond shared topology, not clearance.

dome.limitation: Open dome disk only; no parent surface trimming or lumen union. Boundary positions are preserved, not parent tangent continuity. No surrounding clearance check.

self_contact.limitations: Finite-precision tests, not exact predicates. Other vessels not checked. Adjacent pairs check overlap beyond shared topology, not clearance.

metadata.limitation: Declared source identity; caller must bind original asset to case. Neck uses source-face partitions. No surrounding clearance, branch patency or tangent continuity acceptance. Original case unchanged.
